# Aftertaste Terms of Use

**Effective date:** 23 November 2026

These terms are between you and Paras D Prasad, an individual in India ("we", "us") for the Aftertaste app. By signing in and using Aftertaste you agree to them. If you do not agree, please do not use the app. Our [Privacy Policy](https://theaftertaste.app/privacy) explains how we handle your data.

## 1. What Aftertaste is

Aftertaste is a small, independently run food diary. We provide it as it is, and we may change it, pause it or stop it. We will try to give notice of anything that affects your saved data.

## 2. Your account

You sign in with Google. You must be at least 13 years old (or older if the law where you live requires it). You are responsible for what happens under your account. Tell us if you think someone else has access to it.

## 3. Your content

Your places, visits, dishes, notes, ratings and photos are yours. You give us permission to store them, process them and show them back to you, which is all the app needs in order to work. If you switch on "share my diary" you also let us show the parts of your diary listed in the Privacy Policy to other signed-in users. You can switch that off, export your data or delete your account at any time (Profile, Settings).

You promise that you have the right to upload what you add (for example, photos you took yourself) and that it is not unlawful, hateful, harassing, sexually explicit or someone else's private information.

## 4. Acceptable use

Do not: break the law; try to access other people's private data or accounts; scrape, copy or bulk-download other users' diaries or Google place information; interfere with the app or its servers; use the app to harass others; or reverse engineer it except where the law allows. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these terms.

## 5. Other people's diaries

When someone makes their diary discoverable, it is their opinion at that time, not ours. Ratings and notes can be wrong or out of date. Check opening hours and details yourself.

## 6. Google and third-party content

Place search, place pages and maps come from Google. Your use of them is also subject to the [Google Maps Additional Terms](https://maps.google.com/help/terms_maps/) and the [Google Terms of Service](https://policies.google.com/terms). Place information such as ratings, hours and photos belongs to Google and its contributors and may be incorrect. Links to other sites and services (for example Buy Me a Coffee or your UPI app) are outside our control.

## 7. Optional support and tips

Aftertaste is free to use. Support is voluntary and unlocks nothing. In the Play Store version a tip is a one-time in-app purchase handled by Google Play, so the Play Store's refund rules apply. In other versions you may support us through external services under their own terms. Tips do not buy any feature, service level or ownership.

## 8. Ending things

You can stop using the app and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or end your access if you break these terms or if we shut the service down. After deletion we remove your data as described in the Privacy Policy.

## 9. No warranty and limits on our liability

Aftertaste is provided "as is" and "as available". To the extent the law allows, we do not promise that it will be uninterrupted, error-free or that your data will never be lost (keep your own backup with Export my data), and we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total liability to you is limited to ₹1,000 or the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, whichever is greater. Nothing here limits rights you have by law that cannot be limited.

## 10. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. If the change matters we will update the date above and tell you in the app. Using the app after that means you accept the new terms.

## 11. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. The courts at Dehradun, Uttarakhand have jurisdiction, subject to any mandatory consumer rights you have where you live.

## 12. Contact

[hello@theaftertaste.app](mailto:hello@theaftertaste.app)
